decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records that the master site has no booking system and that sibling location sites handle bookings.
The source is consistent with the existing separate-location-site architecture but does not change the requirement that each location uses a separate Wix site and account.
Assigning booking handling to sibling sites does not change the existing isolation of bookings, revenue, sales, calendars, or reporting by location.
The source addresses where bookings are hosted and does not change separate payment setups or payout handling for individual locations.
The booking-host decision does not change the package catalog or pricing policies for location sites.
The source does not change the Smash Room brand name or its application across sites.
The source does not modify how visitors select a location or how they are routed; those behaviors were already established separately.
The allocation of booking functionality between the master and sibling sites does not necessarily change the Bay Area SEO-preservation requirement.
The source does not change the visual design reference, layout, navigation style, or design scope.
The booking-host decision does not change the reusable template strategy or support for adding future locations.
